description: This file defines a ConfigProvider class for the laminas-diactoros package. It provides configuration data including dependencies (factories and services) and component-specific settings related to proxies and headers.

classes.name: ConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides configuration array for laminas-diactoros, including dependencies and component settings.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Returns the main configuration array with dependencies and component configs.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array mapping interface classes to their respective factory classes.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration related to proxy headers and trusted proxies.
